detail: Full summary: Twining's worktree-aware shared store is a genuine differentiator against BOTH Zilliz tools: claude-context keys Milvus collections on MD5(absolute path) — every linked worktree/clone/rename gets a separate full index and embedding spend, and the collection-name override deliberately re-appends the path hash so team/cross-machine sharing is structurally impossible (open issues #271/#190/#133, PRs #411/#410 unmerged); memsearch has the analogous store-fork problem (#631).
